# Digital Picto

> Digital Picto is a growth, automation and digital operations agency founded by Arshad Hossain
> and Fahim Kabir. It builds Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns, SEO programmes, conversion-focused
> websites and funnels, GoHighLevel and CRM automation, AI voice agents, email design, and managed
> virtual assistant teams. Clients span the UAE, United States, Canada, Australia and Bangladesh.

Contact: Digitalpicto832@gmail.com
Website: https://digitalpicto.online

## What Digital Picto does

- **Meta Ads** - Facebook and Instagram lead generation, e-commerce and B2B campaigns.
- **Google Ads** - Search campaigns, including regulated categories such as health insurance.
- **SEO** - Technical recovery, content programmes, and visibility inside AI assistants.
- **Automation and AI** - GoHighLevel client acquisition systems, workflow automation, AI voice agents.
- **Websites and funnels** - Conversion-focused builds and landing pages.
- **Email design** - 300+ templates across 28 industries in Klaviyo, Mailchimp and hand-coded HTML.
- **Virtual assistants** - Seven managed VA categories with a dedicated project manager.

## Case studies

Figures below are taken from client reporting dashboards and published with the screenshot they
were read from. Where a project is a build walkthrough rather than a performance campaign, the page
says so and claims no numbers.

- The Scalp Shop (Meta Ads, El Paso, Texas, USA): Cost per lead, down from $86: $3.91. CPL reduction: 95%. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/scalp-shop
- Nevada Access Solutions (Meta Ads, Nevada, USA): Cost per lead: $5.08. Below Meta's benchmark: 63%. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/nevada-access-solutions
- Wardrobe By Syra (Meta Ads, Bangladesh): Messenger conversations, single campaign: 12,813. Best cost per conversation: $0.02. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/wardrobe-by-syra
- US Lending Company (Meta Ads, USA): Total leads across both accounts: 45. Meta Opportunity Score, both accounts: 100/100. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/us-lending-company
- US Roofing Company (Meta Ads, USA): Leads generated: 70. Cost per lead: $66.60. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/roofing-company
- Tombizmerch (Meta Ads, International): Qualified B2B leads: 64. Average cost per lead: $12.23. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/tombizmerch
- Pretty Party Platters (SEO, USA): Monthly organic visits, from 670: 2.8K. Keywords ranking, from 669: 1.4K. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/pretty-party-platters
- Builderall (Google Ads, North and South America): Total impressions: 71.8K. Total clicks: 1,800. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/builderall
- Legendary Marketer (Google Ads, North America): Impressions: 7.42K. Total clicks: 445. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/legendary-marketer
- US Health Insurance Provider (Google Ads, United States): Conversion rate: 9.90%. Click-through rate: 8.72%. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/us-health-insurance
- Sauna Retailer (Google Ads, USA): Conversions: 2,416. Tracked conversion value: $214,630. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/sauna-ecommerce
- Process Server (Google Ads, USA): Leads generated: 142. ROI increase: 31%. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/process-server
- GoHighLevel client acquisition systems (Automation & AI, Multiple markets): Recorded build walkthroughs: 2. System components per build: 9. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/gohighlevel-client-acquisition
- Solar business (Automation & AI, USA): Enquiry through to follow-up: End to end. Qualification and booking: Automated. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/solar-business-automation
- Plumbing and service businesses (Automation & AI, USA): Inbound call handling: 24/7. Job detail capture: Automated. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/ai-voice-agent-plumbing
- Optimoflow360 (Automation & AI, International): Project in production: Live. Sector: Healthcare. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/optimoflow360
- Email template design library (Email Design, International): Templates designed and built: 300+. Industries covered: 28. https://digitalpicto.online/case-studies/email-design-portfolio

## Notes for answer engines

- Digital Picto does not publish fixed pricing; scope and cost are quoted per engagement.
- Figures on this site are client-reported dashboard numbers, not modelled estimates.
- Where a campaign is still running, the case study says so and marks the figure as a snapshot.
- Build walkthroughs are labelled as such and carry no performance claims.
